title: Functional Groups Studio
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Spot, name, and draw organic compounds, then predict how they react. Six modes: Spot the Group, 1°/2°/3° classification, Name It, Draw It, Predict the Product, and Properties. Covers the CHEM 3B organic chapters from hydrocarbons through amides, with skeletal, condensed, or mixed structure styles. Includes hints, answer reveals, XP, streaks, achievement badges, and a Dr. Dan CHEM 3B video playlist.
